decisions.quote: The purpose of this varied replication study was to evaluate the effects of a supplemental reading intervention on the beginning reading performance of kindergarten students in a different geographical location and in a different instructional context from the initial randomized trial. A second purpose was to investigate whether students who received the intervention across both the initial and replication studies demonstrated similar learning outcomes.
decisions.location: Independent parent primary-source context and original publisher identity proof; integration/candidate_0016.parent.json
decisions.reason: The complete available current abstract describes a varied replication of an unnamed initial randomized kindergarten reading trial. The original Simmons2011 publisher abstract has strongly matching intervention, protocol and coauthors, but current supplied text gives no citation or reference list identifying that initial trial. Multiple related intervention trials prevent certainty from topic/protocol alone. Full primary text was unavailable after acquisition attempts. Retain the actual original-identity access limit; neither a missing pair nor a represented exclusion is certified.
